findings.title: Whole percent passed to a basis-points parameter
findings.description: pricing.Apply now takes basis points (divides by 10000) but Cart.Total passes PercentOff, which is a whole percent (0-100); a 10% coupon becomes 0.1%. Convert with `int64(c.PercentOff)*100` or give Apply a percent-based wrapper.
findings.suggestion: Pass int64(c.PercentOff)*100 to pricing.Apply (or rename the cart field to a bps value).
